title: Streamline prefix/suffix affordances and masked-input interaction patterns
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Multiple input variants (masked inputs, currency/phone/date fields) use inconsistent prefix/suffix affordances and conflicting focus behaviors across densities. This leads to surprising cursor jumps, inconsistent screen-reader reads, and repeated engineering bugfixes across teams.

Goal: Define a single, accessible interaction protocol for inputs that use non-editable prefixes/suffixes and for masked inputs. Deliver a spec, token mappings, and a small set of visual/behavioral variants for engineering to implement (default, compact, and dense). Ensure parity across desktop and mobile densities and compatibility with current form validation states and assistive text patterns.

Scope: TextField (single-line), NumberField, MaskedInput (phone, SSN, credit-card), Select with adornments, and Toggle inline inputs. Work includes token adjustments (padding, hit targets), interaction prototypes, voiceover/JAWS notes, and a QA checklist. Out of scope: full redesign of autocomplete chips and multi-value token inputs (separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Spec doc published in Drive with annotated Figma frames for default/compact/dense
Accessible behavior defined: screen reader announcement, focus order, and caret placement rules for prefixed fields
Engineering acceptance PR implementing tokens and behavior for TextField and MaskedInput created and linked
Regression test checklist added to component repo and e2e tests covering caret stability and validation aria announcements
Design review sign-off from PM (Arjun Patel) and Accessibility lead (Priya Kaur)
comments: 2025-03-04 Maya Chen: Created ticket after pairing with customer-support about three separate incidents where phone input caret jumped to the end when toggling country prefix. Logged artifacts: Figma exploratory frames (link below) and initial token suggestions.

2025-03-06 Zoe Ramirez: Prototype built in Figma covering prefix as pseudo-element vs separate node. Observed trade-offs: pseudo-element reduces DOM noise but confuses SR announcement. Added both variants to spec for evaluation.

2025-03-08 Priya Kaur: Accessibility review notes: prefer separate non-editable content with aria-hidden=false when content conveys locale (e.g., +1). For purely decorative currency symbol mark as aria-hidden. Added screen reader examples for VoiceOver and NVDA.

2025-03-09 Arjun Patel (PM): Clarified product constraint: must not change existing API surface for dedicated customers; behavior must be opt-in via config flag for rollout. Added requirement to acceptance criteria.
2025-03-11 Zoe Ramirez: Pulled token PR (#4532) to update input padding scale and hit target for compact density. Engineering requests a follow-up for unit tests around masked caret logic.
2025-03-12 Maya Chen: Design review scheduled. Added QA checklist and a short runbook for handling customer-reported caret regressions during rollout.
prs: components: PR #4532 — update input tokens and padding (merged)
console: PR #1204 — live rollout flag for old/input-behavior (open)
decisions: Use a separate non-editable DOM node for informative prefixes (country code) to allow explicit aria-label control and predictable focus handling.
Keep decorative symbols (currency) aria-hidden to avoid verbose SR output unless the product layer requires semantic currency context.
Adopt a conservative rollout: opt-in runtime flag + canary on staging then gradual launch to avoid breaking Dedicated customers.
Token change limited to horizontal padding and an extra 4px hit expansion for compact density to reduce caret-clipping issues.
blockers: Need final accessibility sign-off from Priya Kaur on NVDA examples before merging behavior PR
Backend teams need to confirm that MaskedInput sanitization logic won't break with separate prefix node (compatibility check with legacy validation hooks)
QA team bandwidth constrained during Cycle 2025-W10; e2e tests may be delayed one week
follow_up_tasks: Create ENG sub-task to add e2e tests for caret stability across browsers
Audit Dedicated customer configs for opt-in flag and announce breaking changes in next customer newsletter
Add localization note for prefixes that vary by locale in the spec and include translator examples
